faq.q: What is a team headshot template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made look with one backdrop, one crop, and one light. Add each approved photo and get a matching row in minutes, without a portrait shoot.

faq.q: How does a team template work?
faq.a: You add each photo, set one backdrop, and save squares for the about page. A short intro can be drafted, and an AI actor can speak it beside the row.

faq.q: Why use this instead of hiring a photographer?
faq.a: It is faster and costs less than finding one date the whole staff can attend. A new hire joins the row when they send an approved photo.

faq.q: Who is a team template for?
faq.a: Shop owners and small teams that should look like one staff on the site. Anyone who updates the about page can run it.

faq.q: Can a beginner make the set?
faq.a: Yes. Upload each approved photo and pick the look. You do not need an editing background.
A shop, a clinic desk, and a software team all fit when the page should read as one staff. The trade you sell does not change the crop.

faq.q: Can I upload photos the team already approved?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a face photo each person agreed to, plus a logo on the intro if you want one. Faces come only from those approved photos.

faq.q: Which sites and sizes fit the intro?
faq.a: Yes. Squares stay on the site. The intro can go to LinkedIn at 1:1, a Story at 9:16, or an embed at 16:9.

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan to use a template?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I use the portraits in ads and client work?
faq.a: Yes, if each person agreed to that use. The squares can go on the site and in a deck, and the intro can run as an ad. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of matching by hand?
faq.a: The look locks one backdrop and one crop, so a new hire can sit beside the owner without a layout you build by hand.

definition.title: What Is a Team Headshot Template?
paras: A team headshot template gives a staff page one backdrop, one crop, and one light. Each portrait starts from a photo that person approved.
The portraits are ready for the site or a deck. Names stay in text beside the image, so a new job title does not need a new photo.

reasons.h2: Why a Template Beats Starting Blank
reasons.lead: A new hire can be on the about page this week, without booking a portrait day.

items.d: The look runs on photos the team already approved, so the page does not wait on a studio hold.

items.t: Credits Instead of a Shoot Fee
items.d: Each portrait spends credits on the paid plan you already have. Money you do not pay a studio can stay on ads.

items.t: More Than One Version to Test
items.d: Make the row once, then a second intro line for another audience. Keep the version you want to publish.

items.t: Change the Line and Run It Again
items.d: Change a role in the text, or rewrite the intro, and run it again. A new title is not a new booking.

items.t: No Hold on a Creator Calendar
items.d: The look is ready when a new hire sends an approved photo. You are not waiting on a photographer.
The new hire gets the same backdrop and crop, so you are not rebuilding the row for one person.
